scripts.//verify: Shared gate. Everything MUST be built before linting: type-aware lint resolves workspace imports through each package's dist/*.d.mts, and it also covers examples/ — which need @zintl-examples/* dists and vinext's generated .next types. On a fresh checkout, linting first yields ~172 phantom 'Cannot find module' errors.
scripts.verify: vpr build:examples && vp lint && knip && vp test && vp fmt --check
scripts.ready: vpr build:examples && vp lint && knip && vp test && vp fmt && vp run bench
scripts.//browsers: The browsers `test:contracts` drives. A script rather than an inline CI command on purpose: knip resolves the root's `@playwright/test` through this script, and CI runs the same line you would.
scripts.//smoke: Outside-in publish gate: packs the real tarballs, installs them with npm into a throwaway app outside this workspace, and builds against stock Vite. Needs network. Run before releasing.
